meta.title: RampCheck — check if your car will clear the ramp
meta.description: Check geometrically whether your car can descend a ramp without scraping. Enter ramp angle, clearance and wheelbase.

header.tagline: Will your car clear the ramp without scraping?

form.clearanceHelp: Distance from the ground to the flat underbody between the axles.
form.wheelbaseHelp: Distance between the centres of the front and rear axles.
form.marginHelp: How much free space you want to keep between the underbody and the ramp.

result.successBody: The car should clear the ramp with the required margin.
result.warningBody: The car should make it, but the margin is below your minimum.
result.errorBody: About {missing} cm of clearance is missing.

phase.critical: Critical point: the car straddles the ramp crest symmetrically.

done.success: The car made it down without scraping.
done.warning: The car made it down, but the gap over the crest is below your margin.
done.error: The underbody hit the ramp crest.

sim.failed: The simulation could not start in this browser (WebGL/WebGPU). See the console for details.

explain.title: How we decide whether the car hits
explain.lead: The worst moment of the descent, as in the simulation: rear wheel on the flat entry, front wheel on the ramp, car pitched by θ/2.
explain.invalid: Fix the inputs to see the calculation.
explain.overviewLabel: Car pitched over the ramp crest
explain.zoom: Crest zoom ×{k} (same scale vertically and horizontally)
explain.step1: Worst moment: the car straddles the crest symmetrically, both wheels equally far from it.
explain.step2: This is how far the crest rises above the wheel line:
explain.step3: The floor sits c above the wheel line, so over the crest there is:
explain.verdictError: Negative → the underbody hits the ramp crest.
explain.verdictWarning: ≥ 0 but below the {margin} cm margin → it passes, barely.
explain.critical: Limit angle for this car: θ = 2·atan(2c/L) = {angle}°

info.howBody: RampCheck uses a simplified 2D geometric model with a flat underbody. It accounts for wheelbase, clearance and ramp angle.
info.clearanceBody: Distance from the ground to the flat underbody between the axles — the model does not include local protruding parts.

disclaimer: Note: The result is a simplified geometric analysis. Real clearance may depend on suspension travel, load, tyres, underbody shape, uneven surfaces and the actual ramp profile. This is not a guarantee of a safe pass.

errors.clearance: Clearance must be between 0.1 and 100 cm.
errors.wheelbase: Wheelbase must be between 100 and 500 cm.
errors.margin: Margin must be between 0 and 50 cm.
